title: ORBIT blocked alternative-venue inventory
description: A deployment input. FuelCore.setBlockedVenueCodehash reverts once the token launches, so this file is the complete and final inventory for the deployment it is used with: anything omitted can never be added later. Point BLOCKED_VENUE_INVENTORY_PATH at a copy of this shape.

observedAtBlock.description: The block the codehashes below were read at. A codehash is only meaningful against the runtime code of a specific contract at a specific time.

entries.description: May be empty, which narrows the ADR 0002 claim to the single sealed-route test venue that every deployment blocks.

label.description: Recorded in the deployment manifest so health can name the venue rather than print a bare hash.

address.description: The instance the codehash was observed at.

source.description: Where the address came from, so a reviewer can re-derive it.

verifiedBy.description: How the contract's identity was confirmed, rather than assumed from a remembered address.

rationale.description: Why this contract is the right unit to block.
